item.content:encoded: DescriptionSanic's HTTP/1.1 chunked-body handling does not fully consume the trailer-part after the terminating 0\r\n chunk. Because of that, attacker-controlled bytes left in the connection buffer after the first chunked request can be interpreted as the start of a new HTTP request on the same keep-alive connection.
